title: Define meaningful progress and durable incident identity
limitations: The ledger records progress and incident budgets. It does not admit tasks, start repairs, restart processes, or write native task status.
An observation cannot refund a spent incident budget or grant completion authority. A new stage or defect opens a separate incident; the previous incident keeps its spent counts.
Unverified entry into the merge stage is recorded and does not move the progress cursor.
The sealed interpreter /usr/bin/python3.12 does not provide pytest on the authoritative PATH. The progress suite was executed with the workspace virtualenv that provides pytest 9.1.1.
This receipt does not grant campaign completion or task completion.
